7865.title: Docs editor has no link activation path
7865.rootCauseOneLine: Tiptap link opening is disabled, with no replacement click handler or callback connecting links to Docs navigation.
7865.proposedFix: Handle links once in the shared editor, resolve vault-relative Markdown paths against the current note, and use the existing Docs navigation and HTTP(S) URL-opening capabilities.
7865.caveats: Two clean component-level reproductions on Linux; packaged macOS and live Connect sessions were not run. No external destination was fetched.
